units.source_text: 千重子说着，把真一引到回廊另一个拐弯的地方。

en.t: As Chieko spoke, she led Shinichi to another turn in the corridor.

units.source_text: 那里有一棵樱树，枝丫凌空伸张着。

en.t: There stood a cherry tree, its branches spreading out into the air.

units.source_text: 真一也站在旁边，望着那棵樱树。

en.t: Shinichi also stood beside her, gazing at that cherry tree.
